read.thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT up 25% to Rs 4,588 cr with Auto conso PBIT margin up 110 bps QoQ to 8.8%, but Farm PBIT fell 14% YoY and the deck guides tractor margin pressure into Q3 on drought and commodity costs.

utilisation.quote: HCV capacity completely utilised to meet higher new Blazo demand; Capacity expansion being planned

capex.quote: Creating additional NU_IQ capacity in Chakan of 10k p.m. (92k operational capacity by F28 exit)

triggers.quote: Core Tractor to see some pressure in Q3, Improvement in Q4, Normalcy in F28

adds.what: NU_IQ capacity at Chakan, +10k units per month (to 92k operational capacity by F28 exit)

growth.why: Guidance is mixed: SUV volume growth of mid-to-high teens for FY27 is backed by a partial capacity story (NU_IQ +10k units/month at Chakan, live by FY28 exit, plus fully utilised HCV capacity to meet Blazo demand), while the tractor industry outlook was cut to flattish and LCV industry growth is guided at double digits without company-specific numbers.
